messages:
Nina Park: heads up — billing batch 2026-03 generated invoice INV-202603-8123 for Acme Data (acme-9). total_cents=234000 but invoices.lines = [] in DB, PDF renders $2,340.00 with blank details.
Ethan Ruiz: yikes. did the invoice builder throw or is this a renderer issue?
Nina Park: checked logs: InvoiceWriter wrote invoice after total calc. earlier there was an exception in line assembly: 
```
ERROR ProrationV2: NoUsageFound(customer=acme-9)
  File "services/billing/proration/v2.py", line 51, in calculate_lines
    raise NoUsageFound(customer_id)
```
but caller caught and continued.
BillingBot: automated-alert: billing-run 2026-03-21T04:12Z finished with warnings. 5 invoices with total>0 and empty lines detected. job=billing-20260321-04:12.
Priya Shah: run a quick sweep: 
SELECT count(*) FROM invoices WHERE array_length(lines,1)=0 AND total_amount_cents>0 AND created_at::date='2026-03-21';
-- RESULT: 5
Leo Winters: 5 affected, 1 is enterprise. This aligns with the proration.v2 feature flip on 2026-03-20. We should rollback flag and replay.
Ethan Ruiz: agreed. quick mitigation: patch invoice_writer to abort persistence when lines_count=0 unless flagged as credit_memo. I can open a hotfix PR.
Nina Park: Priya, please create an incident ticket and draft a short customer note for affected accounts in case invoices already mailed.
Priya Shah: created TICK-4599 (invoice-empty-lines). linking logs and assigning to @eng-billing.
Ethan Ruiz: I'll send the PR and coordinate rollback of proration.v2. Once flag off, we'll re-run billing on a clone and reconcile diffs before reissuing corrected invoices.
Nina Park: thanks. tagging @FinanceOps for credit memo approval. Closing thread; follow-up in TICK-4599.
